description:
In Manager.io (Northwind Traders business), use the 'Batch Create' feature to import three new inventory items at once. 

1. Navigate to the **Inventory Items** tab.
2. Click the **Batch Create** button.
3. Copy and paste the following data exactly into the text area:

ItemName	ItemCode	Description	SalesPrice
Hokkaido Garlic Salt	SEA-001	Premium garlic salt from Hokkaido	15.50
Smoked Paprika Tin	SEA-002	Authentic Spanish smoked paprika	9.25
Truffle Infused Oil	SEA-003	White truffle oil 250ml	28.00

4. Click Next, confirm the column mappings (ItemName -> Item Name, ItemCode -> Item Code, SalesPrice -> Sales Price), and finish the import.

Credentials: Username = administrator, Password = (leave empty).
